g.text: AMD Ryzen 9 3900 (Zen 2, 12 cores), DDR4, Ubuntu 24.04, CPU only, 8 threads; shared machine, load average about 8-14 from other work. 6 repetitions

g.text: per engine and prompt length, 128 new tokens, greedy; bars are medians.

g.text: The Veltra and llama.cpp bars come from one benchmark session, the two ik_llama.cpp bars from a second one on the same machine; see the percentage

g.text: Model files differ: llama.cpp and ik_llama.cpp ran a GGUF with higher-precision attention; Veltra ran its own file (same expert weights, mostly 3-bit

g.text: q/o attention, int8 output head and embeddings). Part of the speed difference comes from the file.
